moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 65
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description:
Water (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description:
Poison (Special)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description:
Water (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description:
Poison (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

Accuracy: 100

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Shuca Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ground-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Shell Bell
items.description: After an attack, holder gains 1/8 of the damage in HP dealt to other Pokemon.

items.name: Big Root
items.description: Holder gains 1.3x HP from draining/Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Leech Seed/Strength Sap.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

abilities.name: Electromorphosis
abilities.description: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.
